| spellname = Celestial Cleansing

| description = Fills your target's body with celestial cleansing light, healing 175 hit points every 6 seconds for 24 secs (between 4-5 ticks). This spell has the potential to tick a 5th time, totaling 875 hit-points, depending on when it lands on your target (how other tick based spells work). The overall mana efficiency is 3.88 or 3.11 hp/m. 

Added post-Velious launch [http://www.project1999.com/forums/showpost.php?p=1176734&postcount=8].
